result.instructions: Tools for TrueContext, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which forms were submitted in the last 7 days, and who sent them?"; "List the FormSpaces in our account and the forms in each one."; "Show the incomplete form submissions that are waiting for a reassignment.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TrueContext data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run truecontext_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run truecontext_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run truecontext_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. truecontext_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: truecontext_list_formspaces
tools.title: List FormSpaces
tools.description: List the FormSpaces (work areas) in your TrueContext account. FormSpace ids go into the other tools. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces.

q.description: Filter: text that the item name contains.

tools.name: truecontext_get_formspace
tools.title: Get a FormSpace
tools.description: Get the details of one FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in one FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms.

q.description: Filter: text that the item name contains.

tools.name: truecontext_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Get the details of one form in a FormSpace. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms/{formId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_form_versions
tools.title: List form versions
tools.description: List the versions (iterations) of one form. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms/{formId}/iterations.

tools.name: truecontext_get_form_version
tools.title: Get a form version
tools.description: Get the details of one form version. Uses GET /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/forms/{formId}/iterations/{formVersionId}.

tools.name: truecontext_list_submissions
tools.title: List form submissions
tools.description: List dispatched and submitted forms (form submissions). Filter by name, FormSpace, form, version, group, user or state. Dates use the ftime field with stime and etime. Uses GET /api/1.1/data.

name.description: Text that the submission name contains.

gids.description: Comma-separated group ids (groups of the submitting user).

workflowState.description: Workflow state: Started, Dispatched, Cancelled, Completed, Reopened, Incomplete, PendingApproval or ChangesRequested.

dataFlowState.description: Data flow state, for example PendingDownload, Downloaded, Opened, Uploading, Uploaded, Processing or Processed.

ftime.description: Date field to filter on: DispatchedDate, DispatchDueDate, DeviceEntryDate, ServerReceiveDate, DataRecordProcessedDate, DataRecordCompletedDate or DataRecordLastUpdatedDate.

stime.description: Start of the ftime range (ISO 8601 date-time).

etime.description: End of the ftime range (ISO 8601 date-time).

tz.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Amsterdam.

tools.name: truecontext_fetch_data_source
tools.title: Fetch a data source now
tools.description: Ask TrueContext to fetch fresh data for a dynamic data source now, which updates that source. Not for manual upload or user-list sources. Read-only keys cannot use it. Each call runs a new fetch. Uses POST /api/1.1/formspaces/{formSpaceId}/sources/{sourceId}/fetch.

forceFetch.description: Set true to fetch even when TrueContext finds no changes in the source.
